notes: Regional airport observations, not measurements at either field site. The same station record is shown for both sites; topographic and exposure differences are not corrected.
IEM daily summaries combine computed values with reported daily totals; airport days generally use local standard time (1 AM to 1 AM during daylight saving time).
Missing values remain null. IEM trace precipitation (0.0001 inches) is flagged and treated as zero in plotted amounts and sums; trace is not a measured zero. No gap filling or site bias correction.
This is a downloaded snapshot, not a live feed. Original Fahrenheit, inches and knots are retained in the raw CSV; normalized values use Celsius, mm and m/s.
